When requested to review code, make the suggested changes directly as file edits (so they appear as reviewable/applyable changes), and also respond with:
1. A summary of the changes you made.
2. A brief explanation of why each change is needed (e.g., bug, security, readability, convention).

If a suggested change is optional/stylistic rather than a fix, label it as "Suggestion" so it's clear it's not blocking.
